Username.title: AAPI User
Username.description: Informz AAPI user name. Sent as the <User> element inside the SOAP document body.

Password.title: AAPI Password
Password.description: Informz AAPI password. Sent as the <Password> element inside the SOAP document body.

BrandID.title: Brand ID
BrandID.description: Informz brand account ID. Sent as the id attribute of the <Brand> element. Validated by Higher Logic against the IP address registered to the brand.

BrandName.title: Brand Name
BrandName.description: Optional brand name. Sent as the text of the <Brand> element; may be left empty.
